note: 「ServantID 11413 · 仇恨: 125」 -- the servant block states an aggro weight of its own, and that is what `aggro` carries (before this, every summon sat at the engine's 100 fallback). The mirror image of 阿格莱雅's 衣匠: here SPEED is a FLAT number (160, nothing to do with the summoner's speed) while HEALTH is a share of hers. One entry shape covers both spellings -- `flat` only, `percent` only, or both -- which is why the spec is a list of derivations rather than two named fields. ⚠ The text gives no ATTACK/DEFENCE for 「长夜」 either, which is exactly why its attack scales off HEALTH: 50% of a number the panel does state, not a guess at one it does not. ⚠ The quoted 50% is the 忆灵技能1 row the prose is written at (Lv6); the full table is 0.25 (Lv1) → 0.70 (Lv10), and a memosprite skill has no level table in the generated data -- see ROADMAP §12.5 F-10. || 2026-10-02: servant_id = 11413 and all 5 of its skills (data slots [1, 3, 5, 6, 7]), imported from ExcelOutput/AvatarServantSkillConfig.json.
